goal: Implement the Reporter read-only Developer/QA feedback view on an owned report, with secure schema and tests, per Spec Kit 002 tasks T002-T008
acceptance_criteria: Owning Reporter sees Developer/QA entries, source role, time, newest-first and an honest empty state; existing reports remain readable after closure
Direct foreign-reporter, non-reporter and anonymous reads are denied; Reporter cannot write feedback
Markup-like feedback is inert; feedback read error is distinct from empty state
Relevant unit, database, lint and type/build checks are reported with actual outcomes
